frequency_question: How often do targeted ministry-led industrial financing schemes reach formal implementation within a 24-month design-to-notification window?
membership_rule: Includes: centrally sponsored schemes involving capital subsidies, interest subventions, or credit guarantees for specific industrial manufacturing/adoption sectors announced by the Ministry of Heavy Industries. Excludes: minor budgetary reallocations, state-level schemes, and broad taxation changes.

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 major national schemes named; captures the complete set of primary heavy industry subsidy initiatives by this specific ministry in the reference window.
known_gaps: Minor sub-schemes or pilot projects with low capital outlays may not be formally gazetted in the same manner.
skeleton: Major industrial incentive schemes initiated by the Ministry of Heavy Industries that successfully transition from policy intent to formal notification within designated policy cycles.
multiplier: 4 hits out of 4 identified major comparable schemes within the decade.
validity_reason: Based on stable administrative structures and consistent policy continuity within the Union Ministry of Heavy Industries over multi-year election cycles.
